name: Nettskjema
tagline: Online survey, registration and form tool run by the University of Oslo for students and staff of Norwegian universities and colleges that have an agreement, with optional storage in TSD for sensitive data

evidence.quote: Nettskjema er utviklet og designet av Universitetet i Oslo

vendor_entity.note: Public university. Developed and operated by USIT, the IT department of UiO.

evidence.quote: UiO has a list of all procedures foreseen for the Norwegian Social Science Data Services

vendor_country.note: No page states the country of the university in one sentence. Norway is inferred from the Norwegian legal basis (Personal Data Act) and Norwegian bodies named in the terms.

parent_company.note: The university runs the service itself through its IT department (USIT). No separate parent named on the pages read.

evidence.quote: Nettskjema is developed and operated by the University Information Technology Center (USIT) at UiO

parent_country.note: No separate parent company found, so the vendor country applies.

evidence.quote: UiO has a list of all procedures foreseen for the Norwegian Social Science Data Services

eu_representative.note: Based on the vendor being a Norwegian (EEA) public university. Same inference as vendor_country; no page states the EEA establishment in one sentence.

evidence.quote: you can send your questions to behandlingsansvarlig@uio.no

dpo_contact.note: A responsible-processing contact address is published. No named DPO found on the pages read.

evidence.quote: alle servere står på USITs serverrom

hosting_regions.note: Servers are said to be in USIT's server room. The pages read do not name the country or city. Sensitive data can be stored in TSD or Educloud instead.

evidence.quote: Skjemadesign, svar på vanlige skjema og utvalgte metadata lagres i nettskjemas database.

local_first.note: Form design and responses are stored in Nettskjema's database. Responses can also go directly to TSD or Educloud, which are separate storage services.

eu_residency.note: The pages read do not state where Nettskjema's database is physically located.

evidence.quote: alle servere står på USITs serverrom

cloud_providers.note: The security PDF says the runtime is a locally run private cloud (okd, Kubernetes). No commercial cloud provider named for Nettskjema itself.

transfer_mechanism.note: No transfer mechanism stated for Nettskjema. UiO GPT, which the AI features use, names Microsoft Ireland for OpenAI models (see the AI section).

subprocessors_public.note: Searched the UiO Nettskjema pages, the security PDF, the system description and the terms. No sub-processor list for Nettskjema found. A web search also found none.

subprocessors_count.note: No sub-processor list found, so no count.

subprocessors_non_eea.note: No sub-processor list found, so no count.

evidence.quote: Bistand med å få på plass databehandleravtale

dpa.note: Institutions get help to set up a data processing agreement when they order the service. No public DPA document found on the pages read.

evidence.quote: any institutions who have signed a Data processor agreement with UiO/USIT

role.note: The customer institution is the controller. The GPT UiO privacy statement says UiO is controller for its own service data there; this applies to the AI service, not Nettskjema forms.

evidence.quote: Sist endret 24. mars 2025 18:33

privacy_policy_date.note: Date of the Norwegian 'Personvern og vilkår for bruk av Nettskjema' page.

evidence.quote: Persondata skal slettes fra skjema innen 12 måneder etter at siste besvarelse ble levert.

retention_stated.note: The annotated English terms say six months (for deletion of data in submitted responses), and the Norwegian current page says 12 months. The two versions differ.

deletion_on_exit.note: The 12-month rule applies per form after the last response. No description of deletion after ending a customer contract was found.

evidence.quote: Eksport av samtlige besvarelser for et skjema i excel-format eller som tab-separert fil

data_export.note: Export is per form, to Excel or tab-separated files. Also SPSS-ready export. No account-wide export found.

breach_notice.note: No breach notification window found on the pages read. The terms cover deletion, not breach notice.

governing_law.note: No governing-law clause found. The terms refer to the Norwegian Personal Data Act (personopplysningsloven) for processing.

evidence.quote: Husk at det er helt valgfritt å bruke KI.

ai_features.note: Since 2026 an AI assistant in the report and an alt-text generator in the form builder. Editors only; respondents are not affected. Not available for reports on forms that collect sensitive personal data.

evidence.quote: Vår KI baserer seg på UiO GPT
Ved bruk av OpenAI-modeller behandles inn-/utdata midlertidig av Microsoft Azure OpenAI innenfor GDPR-kompatible regioner.

ai_providers.note: Nettskjema's AI runs through UiO GPT. The Nettskjema page does not name the model, and says the model cannot be chosen. UiO GPT also offers open-weight models run on NTNU servers, which the Nettskjema page does not say are used.

trains_on_content.note: The GPT UiO privacy statement says UiO is not the controller for training data. It does not say customer content is excluded from model training.

evidence.quote: Personopplysningene behandles bare midlertidig og vil ikke lagres hos Microsoft.

ai_zero_retention.note: Stated for personal data sent to OpenAI models through Azure, under UiO GPT. Not stated as zero retention for all content. Other GPT UiO models are said to send data to NTNU, which the statement says does not store it.

ai_admin_off.note: The pages say AI use is optional for editors, but do not say an institution admin can switch the AI features off.

ai_act_statement.note: No EU AI Act statement found on the pages read.

certifications.note: The security pages describe UiO's management system (LSIS), risk assessments and OWASP-based testing. No ISO, SOC or similar certificate named.

evidence.quote: Nettskjema er underlagt UiOs ledelsessystem for informasjonssikkerhet (LSIS)

trust_page.note: A dedicated information security page for Nettskjema, with a PDF for institutions that need detail. The risk assessment itself is not published.

evidence.quote: All datatrafikk mellom brukerens nettleser og applikasjonen går over https og krypteres med SSL

encryption.note: The security PDF says data is in most cases not encrypted at rest in Nettskjema's database. Responses for TSD and Educloud are stored in those services. PGP encryption of stored responses was supported until 2025 and is being phased out.

evidence.quote: Applikasjonen sikkerhetstestes jevnlig.

pentest.note: The security PDF says the last penetration test was in November 2024. The report is not shared; the PDF is a summary for institutions.

vuln_disclosure.note: https://www.uio.no/.well-known/security.txt returned 404. No disclosure policy or bug bounty found on the pages read.

incidents.note: Searched UiO news and Datatilsynet-related results. No incident naming Nettskjema found. The 2025 Canvas incident concerns a different system (Instructure), not Nettskjema.

status_page.note: No public status page found. The English About page says the service has approximately 100% uptime, but that is a claim, not a status page.

evidence.quote: Web-login for Feide-brukere (SAML)
OpenID Connect og OAuth2

sso.note: SAML for Feide and ID-porten logins (system description). OpenID Connect and OAuth2 for admin login (security PDF). Local accounts are not used.

evidence.quote: Web-login for Feide-brukere (SAML)

federation.note: Login is through Feide, the Norwegian education identity federation. Federation metadata (SWAMID or eduGAIN) was not checked.

scim.note: No automated user provisioning mentioned on the pages read.

evidence.quote: Innlogging krever tofaktorautentisering.

mfa.note: Stated for ID-porten login. For Feide, the security PDF says two-factor is required by most Feide institutions.

admin_console.note: An admin interface for forms exists. The pages read do not describe user management or usage reports for the institution.

audit_logs.note: The terms say Nettskjema stores information on access rights and changes made to a form. Admin visibility of these logs is not stated.

lms_integration.note: No LMS integration found on the pages read.

vpat.note: The accessibility page links a list of known deviations (uustatus.no) and says the design was built for universal design. No VPAT document found.

evidence.quote: Vi jobber kontinuerlig med å forbedre universell utforming i Nettskjema.

wcag_level.note: No WCAG level stated. The page points to a list of known deviations, so partial conformance is the reading of the vendor's own text.

evidence.quote: Tilgjengelighetserklæring for Nettskjema

accessibility_statement.note: Published in Norwegian; the English page links to it as Norwegian only.

hecvat.note: Not searched for on the pages read.

ferpa.note: Not stated on the pages read.

hipaa_baa.note: Not stated on the pages read. The service is designed for Norwegian privacy law; sensitive data goes to TSD.

section_508.note: Not stated on the pages read.

state_privacy.note: Not stated on the pages read.

uk_gdpr.note: Not stated on the pages read.

au_privacy.note: Not stated on the pages read.

nis2.note: Not stated on the pages read.

evidence.quote: Fri bruk av tjenesten for alle brukere (gjelder kun for de med FEIDE)

free_plan.note: Free for users with Feide at an institution that has an agreement. Organisations without Feide pay per user tier (order page). Not a free plan for the general public.

price_individual.note: No individual price found. Institutional tiers are on the order page in NOK, excl. VAT: from 33 200 for the smallest tier (2026 prices), listed per institution size.

evidence.quote: Institusjoner i Universitet- og Høyskole-sektoren kan kun kjøpe fri tilgang for alle brukerne i organisasjonen.

institutional_licence.note: Site-wide licences by institution size, for universities and colleges with Feide.

edu_discount.note: No student or academic discount found. Institutional tiers are the education route.

evidence.quote: Priser er ikke inkludert MVA.

pricing_public.note: Institutional prices are published. Individual prices are not.

evidence.quote: Spørreskjema, påmeldinger og flervalgsoppgaver
retranskribering av opptak med Nettskjema-Diktafon
Enkel grafisk fremstilling av svar på et skjema

capabilities.note: Interview transcription is through the Nettskjema-Diktafon mobile app, which records and re-transcribes audio.

evidence.quote: Spørreskjema, påmeldinger og flervalgsoppgaver
the respondents can submit answers from a browser on a computer, mobile phone or tablet

platforms.note: Mobile apps Nettskjema-diktafon and Nettskjema-bilde are free to use. Their store platforms (iOS, Android) were not checked.

languages.value: Bokmål, nynorsk and English for the interface; form content can be translated into 10 languages

evidence.quote: Systemspråket styrer hva som brukes på knapper og grafiske elementer i skjemaet og må være enten bokmål, nynorsk eller engelsk.
Det er 10 språk å velge mellom.

languages.note: Interface languages are the system language options. The 10 languages are for AI-assisted translation of form content.

evidence.quote: Se oppdatert dokumentasjonen på https://utv.uio.no/docs/nettskjema/api/

api.note: The older API page is marked phased out as of 14 May 2025 and points to the current documentation. That documentation host did not resolve when checked, so its contents were not read.

open_source.note: Licence not stated on the pages read. The source is kept on UiO's own GitHub Enterprise server.

self_host.note: The service is run by USIT; no page says whether another institution can host it.
